canon: Existing Anki, Brutus, Ancient AI, Relay, Naki and unnamed Annu only. Ancient AI safeguards and obsolete orders shape the route; no new cast.

chapters.title: Broken Canopy
briefing: Annu guard
Foreign riders! The sky wreck has survivors.
Annu sentry
Cut the road. Keep them away from our water.
Brutus
The Ancient AI opened this passage. Four bikes. Ride hard; duck under the branches.

stages.title: Leave the wreck behind
dialogue: Brutus
Throttle forward, steer early. Four times walking speed means less time to correct.
overheard: The aliens are taking the service road!

stages.title: The fallen giants
dialogue: Brutus
Read the open lane beyond the next trunk. Keep the motorcycle upright.
overheard: The fallen trees will slow them!

stages.title: Broken river spans
dialogue: Brutus
Build speed before the ramp. Level the motorcycle before you land.
overheard: They are jumping the broken spans!
Keep the sky people off the ridge!

stages.title: Annu observation line
dialogue: Brutus
They are tracking slow targets. A clean landing is better protection than stopping here.
overheard: Do not chase the fast ones!
They are heading toward our water!

stages.title: The old haul road
dialogue: Brutus
Brake before the bend, accelerate as it opens.
overheard: The aliens reached the haul road!
Take cover by the old freight bays!

stages.title: Floodgate approach
dialogue: Brutus
The pumping station is ahead. Leave the bikes in cover; we continue on foot.
overheard: Keep them away from the reservoir controls!
The old machinery is answering them!

ending: Annu guard
Those foreigners are heading for the pumps. Guard the reservoir!
Ancient AI
Hydraulic access granted. Preserve residential supply.
Anki
We drain the freight channel, and leave their water alone.

chapters.title: The Floodgate
briefing: Ancient AI
Ancestral maintenance route located. Hydraulic controls remain protected.
Annu guard
The sky people opened the old road. Hold the floodgate!
Brutus
Reach the freight relay. Keep their upper reservoir alive.

stages.title: Restore intake pressure
dialogue: Brutus
Open the valve slowly; the old bearings are still carrying pressure.
overheard: They are following the service terraces!
Hold the road to the relay!

stages.title: Open the bypass
dialogue: Brutus
Open the bypass and keep climbing. The upper reservoir must stay full.
overheard: The sky people opened the bypass!

stages.title: Lower the freight basin
dialogue: Brutus
The lower channel is draining. We have a route without cutting off their water.
overheard: They are draining only the freight basin!
Do not let them reach the transmitter!

stages.title: Hold the floodgate transmitter
dialogue: Brutus
Keep the transmitter powered while the Ancient AI releases the freight channel. They are converging on this relay.
overheard: The aliens are sending orders to the old machine!

ending: Ancient AI
Hydraulic balance preserved. Sanctuary archive access restored.
Annu guard
They left our water running. Why are they climbing toward the archive?
Anki
Because we need to know what this gold is keeping alive.
evidence: Brutus
These modern repair plates fit machinery older than Connectuct. The Annu have kept this water system running for generations.
Ancient AI
Upper basin: residential supply. Lower basin: freight overflow. Do not conflate custodial functions.

chapters.title: Sanctuary of Records
briefing: Annu guard
Those visitors can read the ancestors' script. How?
Annu sentry
Then they know where our grid draws gold. Keep them out.
Anki
The Ancient AI preserved these records. Find the abandoned reserve, leave their power alive.

stages.title: The arrival record
dialogue: Brutus
This circuit records our ancestors leaving. We were not the last people to live here.

stages.title: The living grid
dialogue: Brutus
These conductors regulate water and hospitals. Extracting them would endanger the people here.
overheard: The aliens are reading the living-grid ledger!

stages.title: The abandoned reserve
dialogue: Brutus
Retired conductors. This ledger points to material we can reclaim without stripping the living grid.
overheard: The sky people are climbing again!

stages.title: Complete the archive transfer
dialogue: Brutus
The reserve ledger is transmitting. Hold this destination until the AI verifies the reclamation route.
overheard: Keep the foreigners off that console!

ending: Ancient AI
Retired stock located. Reclamation route authorized; active conductors remain protected.
Annu guard
They copied the old ledger. The sky people are going to the foundry.
Brutus
Gold for Connectuct, without tearing out another home. That is our route.
evidence: Anki
Our departure is carved here. Someone kept our history even after we forgot theirs.
Ancient AI
Retired conductors: awaiting reclamation. Active conductors: protected. Resource allocation must preserve the living.

chapters.title: The Hollow Foundry
briefing: Ancient AI
Reclamation suspended. Cooling and freight controls require local confirmation.
Annu guard
Aliens at the furnaces! Keep those foreigners away from the live grid!
Brutus
Restore the service line. We take retired material, nothing still in use.

stages.title: Cold before current
dialogue: Brutus
Cooling first. The furnaces reject a restart while the return loop is dry.
overheard: Keep them away from the live plant!

stages.title: Sort the broken network
dialogue: Brutus
The separator is freeing retired gold components. Follow its service line toward the freight controls.
overheard: The foreigners started the scrap separator!
Their weapons came from the old field cases!

stages.title: The first usable gold
dialogue: Brutus
Refined conductors are coming off the line. Gold is the control material, not the fuel.
overheard: Do not fire into the active control banks!

stages.title: Protect the recovered cargo
dialogue: Brutus
Stay with the sealed cargo. The AI is releasing the freight interlock; the Annu are moving to retake it.
overheard: Sky people at the cargo interlock!

ending: Ancient AI
Recovered stock verified. Freight release requested.
Annu guard
Their crates came from the scrap line. Stop them at the railway!
Anki
Enough to start the repairs. Now we get it home.
evidence: Brutus
Gold regulates these control assemblies. The thermal plant supplies their energy. The archive makes the distinction explicit.
Anki
Every crate is marked retired equipment. We can account for every piece we take.

chapters.title: Blackout Rail
briefing: Annu guard
I heard the foreigners left our water running.
Annu sentry
They still came from space with guns. Hold this rail.
Brutus
The Ancient AI has our freight trapped in quarantine. Reach the departure signal.

stages.title: Restore the yard signal
dialogue: Brutus
Signal power is back. Follow the lit service lane.

stages.title: Free the frozen switch
dialogue: Brutus
The turnout is seized. Energize its heater, then follow the service route to the freight interlock.
overheard: The aliens are heating the seized switch!
They are taking the freight lane!

stages.title: Reserve the freight line
dialogue: Brutus
Cargo route secured. The passenger branch remains isolated from us.
overheard: Sky people at the transfer interlock!
They have left the passenger circuit alone!
Cover the climb to the last signal!

stages.title: Hold the outbound signal
dialogue: Brutus
Keep the departure signal alive. The cargo must clear this yard before we can climb to the mirror.
overheard: The ancient signal is turning green!

ending: Ancient AI
Freight route restored. Departure record still contradicts orbital quarantine.
Annu guard
The old signals are answering them. They are climbing to the sky mirror!
Brutus
That same quarantine spoke before our crash. We need the flight record.
evidence: Anki
The passenger schedules are recent. This is their working railway.
Brutus
The orbital feed and the freight interlock share a much older control network. Reconnecting one woke the other.

chapters.title: The Sky Mirror
briefing: Ancient AI
Approach registry unchanged. Returning vessels must accept historical flight-control handoff.
Annu guard
The aliens are turning our mirrors toward space. Hold the upper terraces!
Anki
Compare the recorder. Find out what brought our ship down.

stages.title: Align azimuth
dialogue: Brutus
The old beacon is transmitting a flight-control handoff that predates our ship.
overheard: Aliens on the lower mirror terrace!
They are turning the western dish!

stages.title: Align elevation
dialogue: Brutus
The flight recorder matches an incompatible quarantine handoff. An obsolete system triggered the fault, not an Annu weapon.
overheard: The foreigners have a recorder from the wreck!
The old beacon is answering them!

stages.title: Rebuild the corridor
dialogue: Brutus
Power the corrected approach channel. We transmit the full flight profile from the destination terrace.
overheard: They are rewriting the approach channel!
Sky people near the last transmitter!

stages.title: Hold the corrected sky corridor
dialogue: Brutus
Protect this transmitter while the corrected flight profile reaches the relay. No one repeats our landing.
overheard: Keep them off the broadcast console!
The foreigners opened a path through the sky!

ending: Ancient AI
Obsolete flight handoff replaced. Safe return corridor confirmed.
Annu guard
It was the old machine that brought them down. They repaired its sky signal.
Brutus
The sky is open. The reserve lock is the last thing between us and home.
evidence: Brutus
The recorder contains a control handoff, then incompatible attitude commands. We have evidence now; the signal alone was never proof.
Ancient AI
Departure register incomplete. Quarantine duration exceeds original maintenance interval. Custodial review overdue.

chapters.title: The Last Reserve
briefing: Ancient AI
Reserve retention and reclamation orders conflict. Custodial review required.
Annu guard
Foreigners below the vault! They brought the charge from their fallen ship!
Anki
The gallery is empty. We open the stone, and leave the living grid intact.

stages.title: Open the sealed gallery
dialogue: Brutus
The gallery is clear. Set the charge in the old survey recess and stand behind stone cover.
overheard: They are opening the abandoned gallery!

stages.title: Verify the reserve
dialogue: Brutus
This stock was removed from service before the Annu rebuilt the surface.
overheard: They are descending into the retired stores!

stages.title: Isolate the transport cradle
dialogue: Brutus
The engine mistakes an obsolete transport lock for a life-support circuit.
overheard: The foreigners found the transport lock!
The machine is issuing two orders at once!
Hold the descent to the transfer controls!

stages.title: Protect the reserve transfer
dialogue: Brutus
Hold the transfer controls while the obsolete lock disconnects. The reserve engine is answering the old orders.
overheard: Sky people at the reserve cradle!
Stay clear of the old discharge channels!

ending: Ancient AI
Obsolete transport lock isolated. Reclamation defense remains engaged.
Annu guard
The reserve engine is waking! Get clear of its sweep!
Brutus
Three mechanical interlocks. Disable the actuators, then restore the original priorities.
evidence: Anki
The charge survived the wreck, the forest and the road. Now we can finally use it for the excavation it was built for.
Brutus
Both instructions are valid separately: preserve the reserve, and reclaim unused stock. The obsolete transport lock prevents the machine distinguishing them.

chapters.title: Ancient Nest
briefing: Ancient AI
Custodial conflict unresolved. Reclamation sweep armed.
Annu guard
The sky foreigners reached the engine! Do not let them tear out the reserve!
Anki
We stop the machinery, not the intelligence. Keep the living systems online.

stages.title: Break the first interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Fire at the amber actuator. When the floor turns amber, move into a dark lane.
overheard: The engine is sweeping the floor!

stages.title: Break the second interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Use the stone baffles between sweeps. The next lock is carrying the load.
overheard: The aliens broke one of the actuators!
The eastern lock is carrying the load!
Keep clear of the glowing lane!

stages.title: Break the final interlock
dialogue: Brutus
Break the last mechanical lock, then reach the custodial console.
overheard: They are disabling the last mechanical lock!
The old machine is still speaking!

stages.title: Bring the gold home
stages.action: Restore custodial priorities and authorize departure
dialogue: Brutus
The actuators are disabled. Hold the departure console while the AI verifies the living grid and releases our cargo.
overheard: Sky people at the departure console!
They are asking the machine to protect the living grid!

ending: Annu guard
The grid is still alive. They took only the reclaimed gold.
Annu sentry
The old machine released their ship. Let them leave.
Brutus
Gold for Connectuct. The archive for our people. At last, a way home.
evidence: Ancient AI
Original custodial priority: sustain the living. Secondary priority: preserve knowledge. Reserve retention: subordinate.
Anki
There is enough here for the repairs, if we bring back the knowledge to keep repairing.
